---
title: A subfigure group from knitr
---

```{r}
#| label: fig-one
#| fig-cap: One figure.
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-two
#| fig-cap: A group.
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - First.
#|   - Second.
#| layout-ncol: 2
plot(1:4)
plot((1:4)^2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: A table.
knitr::kable(data.frame(a = 1, b = 2))
```

References: @fig-one, @fig-two, @fig-two-1, @fig-two-2, @tbl-one.
